Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.
After the repeal of Directive 2006/42/EC, until when do EC type-examination certificates issued under Article 12 of the Directive remain valid?

response.text: Following the repeal of Directive 2006/42/EC, up to what date do EC type-examination certificates granted under Article 12 of that Directive continue to be valid?
